FAQ

Common Questions

Quick answers — the full list lives on our FAQ page.

Which services can I book through this site?

We work with three vetted local partners: Brightline Dental Studio for dental care, Lone Star Plumbing Co. for plumbing, and Hartwell & Grant Law Group for legal help. Each has its own booking form and direct phone line on this site.

Do you serve my city?

We cover Austin plus Round Rock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Georgetown, San Marcos, Kyle, Buda, Leander and Manor. If your city is not listed, call the intake line anyway—we often can help or refer you.

How fast is the response?

Phone calls are answered live 24/7. Form requests get a callback during business hours, typically within 30 minutes, and emergencies are triaged immediately.

Are the businesses licensed and insured?

Yes. Every partner holds current Texas licensing where required (board of dentistry, TSBPE plumbing, State Bar of Texas) and carries active general liability coverage.

Is the estimate or consultation free?

Plumbing diagnostics quotes and legal consultations are free. Dental exams for emergencies include a clear written treatment plan and cost before anything begins.
